name: plumbing
description: URL plan + content map template for plumbing and HVAC contractors (plumbing, water heaters, drains, sewer, gas, heating, air conditioning, indoor air quality). Mixes local-emergency dispatch intent (burst pipes, sewer backups, gas leaks) with local-commercial scheduled-service intent (installs, replacements, tune-ups) and dense city x service cross-product pages.
recommended_certifications: Licensed Plumbing Contractor (state plumbing license, e.g. CA C-36)
Licensed HVAC Contractor (state HVAC license, e.g. CA C-20)
notes: Plumbing/HVAC is a split-intent vertical: emergency services (burst pipe, sewer backup, gas leak) are local_emergency dispatch intent; installs and replacements (water heaters, furnaces, AC, repipes) are local_commercial scheduled-project intent. Plan defaults reflect the mix.
Cross-product pages (/service-areas/{city}/{service}/) are the primary SEO lever in this vertical and are enabled by default.

24/7 / after-hours claims are gated on brand.hours exactly as in the restoration vertical: archetype defaults may carry '24/7' but plan_site's claims sanitizer strips them for any brand whose hours are not actually 24/7. Never assume a plumbing client runs an after-hours dispatch.

Gas leak content requires a safety-first framing rule: the reader is told to leave the building and call 911 / the gas utility's emergency line BEFORE calling any plumber. The content-writer prompt enforces this; never plan gas-leak copy that positions the brand as the first call.

Sister-company awareness: some plumbing clients disclose a related restoration company via the OPTIONAL brand.sister_company field ({name, url, relationship}). When present, content may reference it for water-damage-adjacent topics with 1-2 contextual cross-links max per page. When absent, never invent one. See linking-rules.json sister_company_policy and the prompts.
